featured_reviews.name: Kishor Mishal
featured_reviews.review_text:
Fashion Street looks exciting at first—rows of stalls, trendy clothes, and cheap prices everywhere. But once you actually start exploring, the experience can quickly turn frustrating.
One of the biggest issues is the behavior of some shopkeepers. Bargaining is expected here, but many sellers can come across as pushy or even rude if you don’t agree with their price or decide not to buy. It often feels less like shopping and more like constant pressure.
Then comes the quality problem. While prices are low, a lot of the clothes are cheaply made—loose stitching, thin fabric, and designs that look good at first but don’t last after a few washes. You really have to dig through piles to find something worth buying.
And of course, the crowd. The lanes are narrow, and during peak hours it gets extremely packed. Walking itself becomes difficult, let alone browsing peacefully. The mix of noise, heat, and constant bargaining can get exhausting fast.

featured_reviews.review_text:

Quality of the clothes not so good or not so bad but check properly before buy it sometimes it's defective piece.
Firstly they will tell you very high rates of the things so think about bargaining. Some shopkeepers bargain and some are very rude and do not bargain. So think carefully before buying things.

featured_reviews.review_text: Visit this place if you have good bargaining ability else don't go near this place. Everything is trendy but low cost copy of branded products, you cannot resist this place :) you will get all types of latest trendy clothes here, plus all duplicate perfumes , shades and shoes. Again only if you can bargain hard n know what you are paying for. These products don't last forever but given the price you can't resist them...anyway it's a long stretch of small shoes along the road. You will get tired of shopping here...dont bargain as long as you don't really want to buy something, that way you don't have to face the anger of the shopkeepers. It's fun shopping here just don't except , exceptional quality from the product.

featured_reviews.name: Camo
featured_reviews.review_text:
In my view, this is one of the largest Westside stores in Mumbai, and it feels very much like the brand’s HQ outlet. The store spans two spacious floors, offering a wide range of options to explore. A good tip is to ask the staff about the latest collections on display, upcoming arrivals, or specific products that match your interests.

The staff here are multilingual — at least two languages including English — which makes communication easy. Given the store’s size, peak hours can lead to some queues at the payment kiosks, which might be mildly inconvenient. That said, I had a particularly positive experience when a male staff member went out of his way to help me complete a purchase, even though it was just for a single item. It reflected genuine customer care and efficiency.

Adding to the convenience, the store is directly connected to a Starbucks. It’s perfect for grabbing a coffee after shopping, or starting with one before diving into the store’s offerings.

featured_reviews.name: Rutika Omble
featured_reviews.review_text:
I had the distinct pleasure of visiting the Starbucks at Kala Ghoda, and I must say, the experience was nothing short of exemplary.
Naina and Krisha attended to me with a level of grace, attentiveness, and refinement that one rarely encounters. Their recommendations were both thoughtful and impeccably suited to my preferences, reflecting not only a deep familiarity with the menu but also a genuine desire to ensure a most agreeable experience.
What truly set them apart, however, was their demeanour unfailingly courteous, warmly engaging, and possessed of a quiet humility that made the entire interaction feel effortlessly elegant.
It is no exaggeration to say that their service elevated a simple coffee visit into something altogether more delightful. A thoroughly splendid experience, and one I should be most pleased to repeat.

featured_reviews.name: Anusuya
featured_reviews.review_text:
Westside Fort – A Timeless Favourite

Westside at Fort has always held a special place in my heart. I have been visiting this particular store for the past 16 years and it continues to draw me in not just for its offerings but for the charm it exudes from the outside in.

What truly sets this Westside apart is the beautiful exterior architecture. Housed in a heritage style building its classic facade with arched windows and vintage detailing always catches my eye. There is a certain old world charm to it that makes it stand out from other Westside outlets in the city.

Inside the shopping experience is equally delightful. The women’s section has a lovely collection of Indian kurtas – stylish comfortable, versatile and affordable. Whether I am looking for something casual or festive, I always find something that suits my taste. The shoe section, too, is impressive with a good variety for both men and women.

The cherry on top is the Starbucks housed right within the building. After a satisfying round of shopping, it is the perfect spot to unwind with a coffee and soak in the Fort atmosphere.

Westside Fort is not just a store – it is a comforting familiar space that blends the charm of old Bombay with the convenience of modern retail. A true favourite over the years.

featured_reviews.name: Asha Shajahan
featured_reviews.review_text:
I cannot recommend Roopkala enough! I have purchased many lehengas and sarees from them over the years while visiting Mumbai, and when I wasn’t able to travel to India this time, I knew I could trust them completely with my bridal and special occasion outfits.

A special thank you to Saloni, who provided exceptional service from start to finish. She took the time to understand exactly what I was looking for, patiently showing me multiple designs and outfit options through photos, videos, and video calls. Every outfit was presented beautifully, making the entire experience feel personal and seamless despite being thousands of miles away.

The attention to detail was outstanding. My measurements were taken carefully to ensure an exact fit, and the craftsmanship and quality of the lehengas exceeded my expectations. The outfits arrived beautifully packaged, secure, and in perfect condition. Even more impressive, my order was delivered within just five days of shipment to the United States.

What truly sets Roopkala apart is their customer service. Saloni and the team followed up after delivery to ensure the fit was perfect and that I was completely satisfied with my purchase. At no point did I feel pressured, rushed, or dismissed. They genuinely care about their customers, and when they make a promise, they follow through.

If you’re in the USA and looking for authentic, high-quality Indian clothing from India, Roopkala is my trusted destination and now my go-to boutique. Their outfits are stunning, reasonably priced, beautifully made, and backed by outstanding customer service.

Thank you, Saloni and the entire Roopkala team, for making this such a wonderful experience. I absolutely love my lehengas and look forward to purchasing many more in the future!

featured_reviews.name: Shreya Rathi
featured_reviews.review_text:
I purchased two of my wedding outfits from Roopkala. One lehenga for the reception and one pre drape corset saree for haldi. They have very beautiful collection and a wide range of outfits as per different tastes. Very friendly, very patient and cooperative staff. Panditji (forgive me for the name error if any) had kept the shopping energy going and flowing. My special mention would be to the designers Shital and Chelsi who understood very keenly what I wanted and designed a perfect fit and a customized cape for me. One day trial and with minor changes, both my outfits were done. Really happy with the wedding shopping.
Also shopped a beautiful traditional saree and a couple of dress materials. Love the collection! Kudos!

featured_reviews.review_text:

The team pulled so many beautiful options and colors for me to try on and truly helped me find styles that suited me. They were warm, attentive, and even offered beverages while I browsed.

A special thank-you to Pankaj, Chaudhary, and Manisha — they were all incredibly helpful and patient. They even completed an alteration for me in about 10 minutes, which was amazing.

Overall, Roopkala made shopping feel effortless and enjoyable. Highly recommend stopping in if you want great service, beautiful pieces, and quick tailoring.

Every garment is a statement piece which is still versatile enough, can be styled with many others! The collections are clean, colourful and multifaceted as you! The clothes not only just look good but feel good too! Rareism does not see their garments as fit for any category or size or age ! It is for everyone! It not about just garments but an elaborate thought process that reflects through the collections. Rareism emphasises on that fact that their garments will bring out the “RARE IN YOU”.
BELIEVE . INSPIRE . CONQUER

RARE-ISM : Be yourself / celebrate the uniquen"

featured_reviews.name: Rasika Salgarkar
featured_reviews.review_text: Had a great shopping experience at the Rareism store, thanks to Bhagat Singh. He was extremely helpful and took the time to understand my preferences before suggesting outfits. His recommendations were spot-on, thoughtful, and never pushy, which made the entire experience comfortable and enjoyable. Truly appreciate the effort and styling sense - service like this really stands out!

featured_reviews.name: Darshani Sidhpura
featured_reviews.review_text:
Worst brand experience ever. Absolutely unprofessional and unethical. Specially the ONLINE STORE.

I ordered two shirts, both turned out to be oversized and required exchange. What followed was a nightmare. No pickup agent came despite multiple emails, follow-ups, and complaints. There was absolutely no response or action from the brand for weeks. It took 30 days just to resolve the issue for one shirt.

For the second shirt, I was ultimately forced to courier the parcel myself after receiving an email from the brand stating that their delivery partner is not serviceable in my pincode something they conveniently realised only at the time of return, not at delivery.

To make matters worse, while initiating an exchange, the website only allows replacement with products that are significantly more expensive, and does not permit exchange with any cheaper alternatives. This is a deliberate tactic to force customers into purchasing higher-priced items, which is unfair, misleading, and exploitative.

The brand claims to be “premium,” but offers zero premium service, zero accountability, and zero customer care. The entire process has been stressful, frustrating, and completely avoidable.

This has been the worst shopping experience I have ever had. At this point, the only remedy left is to initiate legal action under consumer law. I would strongly advise others to think twice before ordering.

featured_reviews.name: Neha Bakhre
featured_reviews.review_text: Amazing collection, did my birthday shopping from there. Bhagat Singh sales person was very helpful, he showed each and everything with the patience and understanding my needs. Just like name rare collection.

featured_reviews.name: Jinesh Jain
featured_reviews.review_text: Bhagat Singh Zaheera Raeesa helped me shop my multiple apparels from the store at Palladium. Abdolutely courteous kind and quite great at upselling. Showing me all possible options making me shop 2 times:)

featured_reviews.name: BNI Hyderabad
featured_reviews.review_text:

featured_reviews.name: Gayatri Khatau
featured_reviews.review_text: The personalised service from Raeesa Shaikh makes the experience special .would love to visit again. Zahera Khan at the counter is also very helpful.

featured_reviews.name: Shining Star
featured_reviews.review_text: It was a wonderful experience at Rareism. Good quality stuff and attentive staff. Saeeda went out of her way to make sure I was comfortable and I ended up buying 5 pieces. Will come back for sure ❤️

featured_reviews.name: Sonali Kalwar
featured_reviews.review_text: I had a fantastic first visit to Rareism. The store boasts a diverse range of high-quality products, and the staff, especially Miss Shraddha and Mr. Altamash, were exceptionally helpful and knowledgeable. Their guidance made selecting the perfect item easy and enjoyable. Overall, the experience was excellent, thanks to their outstanding service.
